scenario: [LEXP.7.14.1]: `1 << 64` is 0 -- 2^64 wraps to 0 under the Int wrap of [LEXP.7.13.1]. Masked, it reads `1 << 0` = 1. Guard `(t.x << t.n) == 0`; fact_count 2 confirms it fired. Path: rete/eval.c's SHL arm into int_ops.h's ds_i64_shl (formal/saw/i64_shl.saw); Mercury ds.eval.bit_result.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key
    n: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x << t.n) == 0
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
